question: Can I automatically book a EUR 170 hotel during a trade fair?
answer:
Based on the provided source passages, the answer is:

No, you cannot automatically book a EUR 170 hotel during a trade fair. According to NL-11:S1, if no suitable hotel within the standard limit is available, up to EUR 180 gross per night including breakfast may be approved, but this is not an automatic increase in the hotel limit. Additionally, NL-11:S2 requires two price quotations, trade fair dates, and written approvals from Finance and the manager before booking a hotel above the standard limit.

sources.title: Trade Fair Hotel Exception
sources.heading: Exception
sources.text: If no suitable hotel within the standard limit is available at the destination during a trade fair, up to EUR 180 gross per night including breakfast may be approved. This is not an automatic increase in the hotel limit.

sources.title: Trade Fair Hotel Exception
sources.heading: Evidence
sources.text: Two price quotations and the trade fair dates must be recorded in the travel request before booking. Finance must approve in writing in addition to the manager. Without both approvals, the standard limit in document NL-09 applies.

sources.title: Travel Expense Policy
sources.heading: Hotel costs
sources.text: For business travel within Germany, the standard hotel limit is EUR 120 gross per night, including breakfast. A higher rate requires written manager approval before booking. Document NL-11 also applies during trade fairs.

sources.title: Business Travel Process

sources.text: Every business trip requires manager approval in the service portal before booking. The request must include purpose, dates, destination and estimated total cost. Any hotel rate above the limit must be explicitly identified.
